token.title: 🔑 Tokeni ya GitHub
token.intro: GitHub eddamu okusaba 60 buli ssaawa eri endagiriro etaweereza tokeni. Omuti gwa fork gwonna gusaba nga 32, kale ku mulundi ogw'okubiri biggwaawo. Tokeni esitula ekkomo okutuuka ku 5000 buli ssaawa.
token.step1: Ggulawo Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, oluvannyuma Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: akawunti yo. Okuggwaako: olunaku lwonna, omuti teyetaaga kintu kiwangaala.
token.step4: Tokwata ku lukusa lwonna. Ebikwata ku materekero aga lukale tebyetaaga na lumu ku zo.
token.step5: Kola, oluvannyuma koppa omuwendo gwa {token}. GitHub egulaga omulundi gumu gwokka.
token.classic: Tokeni ey'edda nayo ekola: kola emu nga tolonze scope yonna. Scope enjereere nayo esoma data ya lukale ku sipiidi y'abakakasiddwa.
token.stays: Esigala mu bulawuza eno wansi w'ekisumuluzo {key} era egenda eri {host} yokka. Tewandiikibwa mu kifo ky'endagiriro, kale link gy'ogabana etwala endaba so si bukakafu. Eppeesa wansi w'ekifo ligisangulawo nate wamu n'ekitereke ky'akaseera.
token.persistHow: Teeka tokeni mu fayiro {env} eya seeva ekwata omuko guno, okumpi ne {port}:
token.proxy: era ogitandike ne {make}. Kontena olwo ewandiika ekitundu kya nginx ekigattako omutwe {header} ku proxy ya {path}, kale bulawuza eyita ensibuko yaayo era tefuna tokeni n'akatono. Ekifo kino kibula era buli mugenyi agabana omugatte gumu ogwa 5000 buli ssaawa.
fork.refused404: Tewali nnyiriri za matabi: {message}. 404 wano kiba ttabi eritaliiwo oba ekkubo proxy ya seeva ly'etatwala; mu ngeri zombi omukutu gwa fork waggulu mujjuvu.
fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub eweddeko okusaba kw'essaawa eno, kale tewali nnyiriri za matabi zaasobodde kukubibwa. Omukutu gwa fork waggulu mujjuvu. Yongerako tokeni mu kitundu ky'ekisengejja, oba ggyako ennyiriri z'amatabi mu kitundu ky'endabika okukozesa omugatte ku mukutu gwokka.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub yaddamu {status} ku byafaayo by'enkyukakyuka, kale tewali nnyiriri za matabi zaasobodde kukubibwa. Omukutu gwa fork waggulu mujjuvu.
fork.tagsOrphaned: Ttagi terina lunaku, kale buli esigaddeyo yandisabye okusaba okumu, era omugatte gw'essaawa ogusigaddeyo tegukozesebwa ku ekyo.
fork.axisZoomed: {axis}, ekiseera ky'enkyukakyuka ne ttagi ezitikkiddwa. Ennyiriri za fork enkadde okusinga ekyo zinywezebwa ku lukugiro lwa kkono.
fork.axisWhole: {axis}. Ggulawo tterekero okukuba emikutu gy'enkyukakyuka n'okugatta kwayo; olunyiriri olwo lukendeera ku byafaayo ebyo.
